original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥贡州警察局长就网络流传的殴打视频传唤四名警员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州警察局长博德·奥贾朱尼就一段网络流传的视频传唤四名警员至州警察总部。视频显示约三名警察将一名年轻男子按倒在地并戴上手铐，据称事件发生在桑戈-奥塔的伊贾格巴。该事件引发公众愤怒。目前信息来自单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州警察局长传唤四名涉事警员至州警察总部
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ogun State Commissioner of Police, Bode Ojajuni, has summoned four operatives of the command who were recorded assaulting a young man in a viral video to the state police command headquarters in Eleweran, Abeokuta.

key_facts.fact: 视频显示约三名警察将一名年轻男子按倒在地并戴上手铐
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A video posted on social media showed about three police personnel pinning a young man to the ground, after which he was handcuffed.

key_facts.fact: 据称事件发生在桑戈-奥塔的伊贾格巴，引发公众愤怒
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident, which reportedly occurred at Ijagba, Sango-Ota, drew outrage from members of the public

uncertainties: 事件具体经过及涉事警员责任尚未证实
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
